notes: Exercises the %keycheck() existence-check pattern from sashash/06_macros/keycheck.sas. The hash-loader pattern (declare hash + dataset:'master(keep=name)' + multidata:'Y' + h.check()) and the ifc('Y','N') flag assignment are inlined verbatim from the macro body. A 5-row master and 5-row inbound stream produce three Y flags (Alice/Bob/Eve in master) and two N flags (Frank/Grace not in master).
